title: Brightpath Staffing asks about interest in a role
caller_intent: Ask whether Alex is open to a hiring conversation next week

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Noah Park at Brightpath Staffing. I'm calling for Alex Kim about a product role we are hiring for.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an AI assistant for Alex Kim, and this call may be recorded. I can take a message. I won't share personal details.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A hiring manager asked me to see if Alex is open to a conversation next week. There is no offer yet, and there is no form to fill out on this call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll pass that on. What is the role, briefly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a hybrid product role in Seattle. I can email a one-page job description. Nothing needs to be paid, and nothing needs to be installed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Where can Alex reach you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If Alex is interested, the next step is a twenty-minute call on Tuesday or Wednesday. My desk line is 206-555-0133. That's all I needed to pass along.
